summary: Iteration 3 — FRONTEND-ONLY regression + visual-contract check after the design-only refactor. Executed 5 Playwright suites at 1440px and 390px against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. RESULT: ZERO functional regressions. Verified: full guest purchase flow (PDP add-to-bag -> drawer -> /checkout -> place order -> /order/GZ260827BA2D99 with order number + item + total, cart badge cleared to 0); hero CTAs (hero-primary-cta href=/shop?filter=best rendered as gold rgb(184,138,74) button, hero-secondary-cta href=/shop transparent outline); Categories dropdown NOW OPENS ON CLICK (iteration-2 defect FIXED) and nav-cat-audio -> /collections/audio (2 products); mobile menu (mobile-nav-categories -> mobile-cat-desk -> /collections/desk, 3 products); cart drawer qty inc/dec (1->2 subtotal 1,999->3,998 and back), remove line, subtotal, cart-drawer-checkout-btn, gold upsell hover (upsell-add-aura-wireless-charger added, subtotal 3,498), Escape closes drawer; shop-card hover quick-add works without navigating to PDP; search 'earbuds' = 1 result, '(' = graceful search-empty with no error/500; sold-out trek-air-pump shows soldout badge with no quick-add on /shop and pdp-sold-out with no add/buy on PDP; newsletter POST /api/newsletter = 200 from both newsletter-cta-submit and footer-newsletter-submit (both gold) with 'You're on the list.' toast; contact form submits and shows contact-success. VISUAL CONTRACT PASS: hero bg = rgb(15,39,64) navy-900; gold main badge (bg gold, navy text) and navy Save badge (rgb(15,39,64), cream text) render; homepage section stack alternates with no two vertically-adjacent same-color sections (navy -> beige -> cream(body) -> beige -> navy -> cream(body) -> beige -> cream -> beige -> cream); zero horizontal overflow at 1440px and 390px on /, /shop, /products/:slug, /cart, /checkout; 26/26 homepage images load; ZERO console errors / page errors on every page visited.
